name: The Venus Selfie
description:
The ability to love others requires the ability to love ourselves first. But in times where our self-image is more and more shaped by ideals of beauty, which are determined by social media filters, it is increasingly difficult for us to accept ourselves as we actually are. True beauty comes from the heart.
